As Delhi’s air quality deteriorates, the Supreme Court has flagged vehicular emissions and bumper-to-bumper traffic as major contributors to pollution, questioning the effectiveness of existing measures. With AQI touching 400, GRAP curbs in force and political blame over stubble burning, the Capital’s pollution crisis is back under scrutiny
